p: empty vine: Of which though the grapes were gathered, yet always as it gathered new strength it increased in new wickedness, so that the correction which should have brought them to obedience, only proclaimed their stubbornness.
goodness of his land they have: As they were rich and had abundance.
divided: That is, from God, by serving their false gods.
king: The day will come that God will take away their king, and then they will feel the fruit of their sins, and how they trusted in him in vain; 2Ki 17:6-7.
a covenant: In promising to be faithful toward God.
judgment springeth up as hemlock in: In this way their integrity and fidelity which they pretended, was nothing but bitterness and grief.
fear because of the calves of: When the calf will be carried away.

priests thereof that rejoiced on it: These were certain idolatrous priests, who wore black apparel during their sacrifices, and cried with a loud voice: which superstition Elijah derided, 1Ki 18:27. See Geneva "2Ki 23:5"
Aven: This he speaks in contempt of Bethel. Read Geneva (t) Ho 4:15

sinned from the days of Gibeah: In those days you were as wicked as the Gibeonites, as God there partly declared: for your zeal could not be good in executing God's judgments, seeing your own deeds were as wicked as theirs.
stood: That is, to fight, or, the Israelites remained in that stubbornness from that time.
overtake them: The Israelites were not moved by the example of the Gibeonites to cease from their sins.
that I should chastise them: Because they are so desperate, I will delight to destroy them.
furrows: That is, when they have gathered all their strength together.
tread out the corn: In which is pleasure, whereas in plowing there is labour and pain.
fair neck: I will lay my yoke upon her fat neck.
break up your fallow ground: Read Geneva "Jer 4:3" See Jer 4:4
Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day: That is, Shalmaneser in the destruction of that city spared neither type nor age.
